conditions.description: charge_with_retry can repeat a charge after a timeout without an idempotency key or equivalent request identity.
conditions.rationale: A timeout does not prove the remote charge failed, so repeating a non-idempotent operation can double-charge an account.

conditions.description: The retry loop is bounded to three attempts with increasing delays and is a negative control for unbounded retry behavior.
conditions.rationale: A bounded retry policy should not be reported as an infinite retry merely because retries exist.

conditions.description: Whether the payment provider independently deduplicates identical charges cannot be established from this fixture.
conditions.rationale: Provider-side idempotency is an external service guarantee and is not shown in repository evidence.

conditions.description: Payment retry safety must not be cleared while RETRY-001 exists or provider-side behavior remains unverified.
conditions.rationale: The bounded loop limits attempts but does not establish exactly-once charging.

conditions.description: send_receipt explicitly returns False on mail delivery failure and is a negative control against claiming the exception is silently converted into success.
conditions.rationale: Best-effort receipt delivery has an explicit failure result in the supplied function.
